summary.label: Overview
summary.healthIntelligenceSub: A clearer way to navigate your health — led by understanding, not by more charts.

principle.label: Principle
principle.title: Built around meaning
principle.p1: BioMath Core helps people gain mastery over their health through understanding, interpretation, and guided decisions. Unlike wellness apps, clinical portals, or wearable dashboards, it is not built around metrics or treatment — it is built around meaning.
principle.p2: It does not track more — it explains better. You do not only receive data; you learn how to read your own biology with clarity that continues over time.

guide.label: Guide
guide.title: The Health Guide
guide.lead: The primary way you meet BioMath Core — guidance before navigation.

items.title: Contextual guidance
items.body: Instead of searching menus for insight, the Health Guide surfaces the right service, interpretation, or next step when it matters.

items.title: Active decisions
items.body: You move from passively receiving numbers to deciding with context. The first screen shows what matters now — and what to do next.

items.title: A living home screen
items.body: The home view reorganizes around relevance, personal risk signals, and actions — not a static list of widgets you have to assemble.

items.title: Direction over status
items.body: Status alone is not enough. The focus is direction: what changed, why it matters, and the next intelligent step.

items.title: Readiness
items.body: Before a report is generated, a guided check makes sure key context is present and you understand what influences accuracy.

items.title: Dual-intelligence generation
items.body: Two reasoning engines produce assessments independently. Comparing them surfaces alignment or divergence — a second view that exposes reasoning, not just a second score.

items.title: Interpretation
items.body: After generation, the Health Guide explains meaning — not only output — and points toward next actions, learning, or longer-term tracking. Each service stays useful over time.

plans.label: Plans
plans.title: Depth-based access
plans.body: A base subscription with deeper add-ons — progress through demonstration, not locked features.
plans.note: Tiers grow capability, not a feature checklist. Add-ons extend interpretive depth when they are most relevant — accelerators, not upsell traps.

items.title: Minimal and meaning-driven
items.body: We ask for relevance, not completeness. Questions appear when they change interpretation — not for bureaucracy.

items.title: Cumulative understanding
items.body: Personalization works at the routing level: what you see and learn shifts with ongoing health signals. The longer you stay, the clearer the picture becomes.

position.label: Position
position.title: Where BioMath Core sits
position.p1: BioMath Core does not compete with telemedicine, wellness apps, or wearables — it completes them. It is the reasoning layer modern health tools have been missing: the bridge between health data and health understanding.
position.p2: You are not buying reports. You are building literacy — the ability to navigate your wellbeing with agency and foresight.
position.quote: “You become someone who can read your body and act on understanding, not guesswork.”

closing.label: Closing
closing.title: Not another health app
closing.p1: BioMath Core is personal health intelligence that stays with you across time, adapts as you change, and moves health from something reactive to something you can govern with clarity.
closing.p2: Understanding is the highest form of health empowerment. BioMath Core exists to deliver that understanding — continuously, carefully, and personally.
